summary: Game crash when you shift right click on item in your hotbar to the chest at the same time as you die
description: The Bug A zombie killed me at the same time I shift right click on some block I was trying to put in the chest and the game went saving and it crash 2s after. My game is set to DoImmediateRespawn. Reproduce - Do gamerule doImmediateRespawn true - Get a chest - Get a zombie - Get an item - Open the chest - Right when the zombie kills you shift right click the item into the chest Observed Result The game crashed Expected Result The game wouldn t crash
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Set the gamerule to immediate respawn by entering the command: `/gamerule doImmediateRespawn true`.
3. Obtain a chest and place it in the game world.
4. Summon a zombie to attack you.
5. Obtain an item to place into the chest.
6. Open the chest interface.
7. Right when the zombie kills you, shift right-click the item into the chest.
8. Wait approximately 2 seconds.
9. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.19, 22w24a, 1.19.1 Pre-release 1, 1.19.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.19.1 Pre-release 2 (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when a player attempts to shift-right-click an item from their hotbar into a chest while simultaneously being killed by a zombie. Specifically, the issue occurs when the player is set to use the DoImmediateRespawn gamerule. The sequence to reproduce the bug involves enabling the gamerule for immediate respawn, obtaining a chest, summoning a zombie, and having an item ready in the hotbar. When the player opens the chest and is killed by the zombie at the exact moment they attempt to shift-right-click the item into the chest, the game begins the saving process but crashes approximately two seconds later. The expected behavior is that the game should not crash under these circumstances, allowing the player to respawn and continue gameplay without interruption.
Expected Behavior: When the player dies while attempting to shift-right-click an item from their hotbar into a chest, the game should handle the simultaneous actions without crashing. Instead of crashing, the game should successfully place the item into the chest, and the player should respawn immediately as per the DoImmediateRespawn setting. This expected behavior should occur consistently, allowing for a smooth gameplay experience even during simultaneous actions.
